Today you're hoping for a full stretch of sleep, but you'll check the team chat between feeds in case anything urgent comes up from the accounts firm.

private_lines.Sam: You live in Headingley and work at the small accounts firm on the edge of the city centre, so you're in your usual spot, but this week you're covering the front desk from 7am to noon while the receptionist is on holiday. This morning you're on your feet, distracted, and checking the group chat between visitors and phone calls at the front door.
